title: Objenesis before 3.6 Type Confusion via Class Name Instantiator Cache
description: CVE-2026-116486 is a type confusion vulnerability in Objenesis version 3.0 related to the class name instantiator cache. The vulnerability is categorized under CWE-386, which involves type confusion issues. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided. There is no indication of known exploitation in the wild or available patches.
